request.description: Get all products with English and Arabic descriptions for editing

Get single product content with separate English and Arabic fields for editing.

Response includes:
- name & name_ar (separate fields)
- description & description_ar (separate fields)
- note & note_ar (separate fields)
- All price fields (price, monthly_price, three_months_price, six_months_price, yearly_price)
- Full image URLs
- Category information

request.description:
Get all strategies and posts for a specific day and client. Includes:

- All strategies scheduled for that day
- All posts within each strategy with full details
- Post approvals status (client_approved, admin_approved, marketer_approved, id_approved)
- Post feedbacks with user details
- Post team members
- Creator and updater information
- Client details

Accessible by:
- Admin: Can view any client's strategies by providing client_id
- Marketer: Can view any client's strategies by providing client_id
- Designer: Can view any client's strategies by providing client_id
- Client: Can only view their own strategies (client_id parameter is ignored)
